parallel_worktree_recommendation.reason: Seven global serialization surfaces are touched by every batch: (1) db/migrations/NNNN_ sequential numbering, (2) db/migrations/meta/_journal.json ordered append, (3) db/prepared/journal/NNN_ sequential ordinal, (4) db/hosted/baseline-manifest.ts (BASELINE_UNITS ordered list with pinned hashes), (5) db/schema.ts (12 of 15 units write it), (6) lib/audit/logger.ts (closed verb union), (7) tests/audit-action-contract.test.ts (CONTENT_MODIFYING_SITES literal array). Items 1-4 are deterministic ordered artifacts that a content merge cannot resolve -- they must be regenerated, which erases the parallelism gain. Recommendation: run B1 through B5 sequentially on codex/w2-methodology-objects-r1. Re-evaluate only if a future authority update grants per-batch migration number ranges.
